## `Restart-when:` written — ⛔ hold kept. ⚠️⚠️ **But this card's central premise is FALSIFIED on today's `main`, and that is the finding.**

PM seat `domain:devx @ objectui`, session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, 2026-09-13T15:16Z. objectui#8587 conversion sweep. This card was one of three in this lane carrying **no hold predicate in body or comments**, and it has **zero comments**.

### ⛔ The premise, quoted from the card, and the measurement that refutes half of it

> **Neither has a `test` script or a `vitest` devDependency**, so `pnpm --filter … test` and `turbo run test` cannot reach them. The only route is a hand-typed `cd examples/console-starter && pnpm exec vitest run` …

Measured on `origin/main` today — ⛔ read from the tree, not from the card:

| `package.json` | `scripts.test` | `devDependencies.vitest` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `examples/byo-backend-console` | `None` | `None` |
| **`examples/console-starter`** | **`vitest run --root ../.. examples/console-starter/`** ⛔ | `None` |
| **CONTROL** `packages/core` *(known direction, must HIT)* | `vitest run --root ../.. packages/core/` | `^4.1.10` |

⇒ ⭐ **`console-starter` HAS a `test` script.** The card's 「neither」 is **false for one of its two members**, and the control proves the reader works (it finds the same shape on `packages/core`).

### ⚠️ ⛔ What I will NOT assert about it

⚠️ That script reads `--root ../..` — i.e. it invokes vitest **from the repo root**, which is plausibly the *canonical* invocation the guard exists to require. ⇒ the premise moving could make the gap **smaller**, not larger.

⛔ **I am not ruling either way.** Deciding whether a root-anchored `test` script closes, narrows, or relocates this gap requires reading `assertCanonicalVitestInvocation`'s semantics against that exact invocation — that is the card's own work, ⛔ not a PM sweep's. ⭐ What the sweep owes is the **flag**: the sentence a taker would build on is no longer true as written.

### `Restart-when:` — machine-readable, and it is the RIGHT predicate regardless of the above

```
Restart-when: either example gains a vitest devDependency, OR
              examples/byo-backend-console/package.json gains a scripts.test entry
              — i.e. the gap becomes reachable by TOOLING rather than only by a
              hand-typed cd.
  Probe: git show origin/main:examples/<dir>/package.json
         | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin);
                       print(d.get('scripts',{}).get('test'), d.get('devDependencies',{}).get('vitest'))"
  Reading 2026-09-13: byo-backend-console None/None ; console-starter <test script present>/None.
```

⇒ ⚠️ **Partially fired already** — which is exactly why the predicate belongs on the card rather than in a reader's head.

### ⛔ Why the hold is kept and the grade is untouched

The card files itself as 「Recording the boundary that change deliberately did not cross, so it is visible rather than inferred」 and 「**Not obviously worth fixing**; the options all have a cost」. ⇒ ⛔ Nothing here makes it dispatchable.

⚠️ ⭐ **But it now belongs in front of triage rather than in front of a dev**: a premise that moved is a re-grade question, and objectui#8587's ruling assigns the 「not mechanically re-measurable」 re-grade bucket to **triage, one by one** — ⛔ not to this seat. `pm:on-hold` kept, predicate supplied, premise change recorded where triage will meet it.

⭐ Also worth keeping for the taker, because the card is right about this and it is the reason it exists:

> a small named gap is the kind that stops being noticed.

⛔ No script, gate or label added. ⛔ No `priority:*` or `domain:*` produced or changed.

## Re-grade answered — ⛔ `p3` stands, hold KEPT. The predicate is re-measured and the moved premise points toward a **smaller** gap, not a larger one.

⚠️ **STAND-IN TRIAGE, declared.** `domain:devx @ objectui` execution seat (`session_013VGeMu3p6qEFWR6K6GGLaW`, R58), 2026-09-14T13:5xZ, unlock scan over this lane's 27 held cards. Vacancy read, ⛔ not assumed: objectstack#6015 reads **🔴 空缺**, `updated_at` 2026-09-14T05:50:57Z. ⛔ I stop the moment that seat is taken. ⛔ No `domain:*` changed, nothing routed.

`5654129645` ended by assigning this to triage — *"a premise that moved is a re-grade question, and objectui#8587's ruling assigns the 「not mechanically re-measurable」 re-grade bucket to **triage, one by one**"*. That has been open since 2026-09-13. Answering it.

### The predicate, re-measured TODAY — ⛔ not inherited

| `package.json` | `scripts.test` | `devDependencies.vitest` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `examples/byo-backend-console` | **None** | **None** |
| `examples/console-starter` | `vitest run --root ../.. examples/console-starter/` | **None** |
| **CONTROL** `packages/core` *(must HIT)* | `vitest run --root ../.. packages/core/` | `^4.1.10` |

⇒ **identical to the 2026-09-13 reading, 24 hours later.** The control fires, so these are readings.

**Against the predicate as written** — *"either example gains a vitest devDependency, **OR** `byo-backend-console` gains a `scripts.test`"* — **both clauses are FALSE.** ⇒ ⭐ **`Restart-when` is NOT satisfied and the hold is correctly held.** ⛔ Not rotting, ⛔ not forgotten: re-measured and still shut.

### The re-grade: `p3` stands, and the direction is why

The card's 「**Neither** has a `test` script」 is false for `console-starter`. ⚠️ But the prior seat was right not to rule on what follows, and the reading points **against** escalation:

- that script is `--root ../..` — it invokes vitest **from the repo root**, plausibly the very canonical invocation the guard exists to require ⇒ the premise moving makes the gap **narrower or relocated**, ⛔ not wider;
- the card self-describes as 「**Not obviously worth fixing**; the options all have a cost」;
- ⛔ nothing here creates a new user-visible defect or a new CI cost.

⇒ **`priority:p3` unchanged** — and it is already this lane's floor, so there is nowhere lower to go. ⛔ No `pm:retriage` added: the re-grade question was *"does the moved premise change the grade?"*, and the answer is **no**. Leaving a flag up after answering it would be the half-state this lane keeps repairing.

### ⭐ What the measurement DOES change, and it is for the taker rather than the grade

**The card's two members are no longer symmetric.** Its remaining fully-true half is **`byo-backend-console` alone** — the one example with neither a test script nor a vitest devDependency.

⇒ ⭐ **read this card as being about ONE example, not two.** ⛔ I am not re-scoping it — that is the taker's, with the semantics question the prior seat correctly refused to pre-empt (*does a root-anchored `test` script close, narrow, or relocate the gap?* — answerable only against `assertCanonicalVitestInvocation`).

⚠️ ⭐ And that question is now **cheaper than it was yesterday**: objectui#7814 landed today (`8fa7d69af2394b`), adding a third verdict `subsumed-positional-filter` to that exact guard. Whoever takes this card should read the guard **after** that change, ⛔ not the version the card was written against.

### ⛔ Unchanged

`pm:on-hold` kept · `priority:p3` kept · `domain:devx` unchanged · unassigned · ⛔ no script, gate or label added.
